title: Dear ImGui
concept: Dear ImGui bindings for XIOM — create immediate-mode GUI windows for tools, debug interfaces, and editor panels with minimal code.
why: Traditional retained-mode GUIs are complex. Dear ImGui renders UI from function calls each frame — simple, fast, and ideal for development tools.
tips: ImGui is immediate-mode — you call functions every frame, no widgets to 'store'
Use Begin/End pairs — forgetting End() breaks the UI stack
Dockspace enables drag-and-drop window docking — great for complex tools
ImGui is for DEVELOPMENT TOOLS, not end-user UI — use native UI frameworks for user-facing apps
common_mistakes: Forgetting to call new_frame() / render() — UI doesn't appear
Not calling End() after Begin() — corrupts the UI stack
Using ImGui for end-user applications — it's designed for tooling, not polished consumer UIs
